I’m glad to hear someone has mentioned impeachment of Judge Clarence Thomas. 

When I conduct non-harassment training, I always discuss Anita Hill’s accusations. She deserves justice. Our country deserves better. #msnbc #metoo
@AshaRangappa_ @DanasiaShavone I appreciate the sentiment, but when Black Americans are fighting for equal rights the police act very similar in the U.S. #blacklivesmatter https://t.co/Jr7CB2h2PM
@RVAwonk It takes a lot of courage to come forward. This woman will need support from the public as she comes forward against Kavanaugh. The Right will get nasty. #metoo

@washingtonpost Kavanaugh's confirmation should be delayed and he should be questioned again with these additional revelations of sexual violence. We also need the media to not get distracted and continue to focus on this story. #metoo

I keep seeing a disturbing trend of some black men attacking the #metoo movement that was created by a black woman. Black women always support black men and I expect black men to support black women. Period.
